conventions.exact: lb == ub is proven; ub is then filled in with lb
conventions.ub_null: no upper bound is quoted on the page for this cell (d=4 tables and the A(n,8,8)/A(n,12,12)/A(n,14,14) lower-bound strips quote lower bounds only; a few cells read 'LB-...')
conventions.lb_null: cells of the form '-UB' quote an upper bound only
conventions.labels: for a cell without a dash both bounds share the label list, which is reported in lb_label
conventions.nw: true when the page shows the bound on a yellow background (first given on the page itself)
conventions.be: true for d=4 cells with class 'be' (Brouwer & Etzion 2011)
conventions.symmetry: entries are as printed; A(n,d,w) = A(n,d,n-w) is NOT materialised here

lost_codes.note: BSSS lower bound has no surviving explicit construction; best_explicit_lb is the largest code actually available.
